text:
Imagine it's a Saturday and you have the whole day free. Which of these would you most enjoy doing?

- 🖥️ Building a website or app
- 🔧 Taking apart a gadget to see how it works
- 🏗️ Visiting a construction site or sketching a building design
- 🔬 Watching a biology documentary or doing a science experiment
- ⚡ Tinkering with circuits or electronics

Just pick what feels most natural to you, or describe in your own words!

Think about your favourite YouTube channels or social media pages. Are they mostly about:

- 💻 Tech, coding, or AI
- 🏎️ Cars, machines, or how things are made
- 🏠 Architecture, city planning, or mega-structures
- 🧬 Medicine, biology, or health
- 📱 Gadgets, electronics, or hardware reviews

Or tell me what actually gets you excited — no wrong answers!

In a school group project, which role do you naturally take?

- 🧠 The one who plans the logic and strategy
- 🎨 The one who designs how it looks and feels
- 🛠️ The one who builds the physical model or prototype
- 📊 The one who does the research and calculations

There's no right answer — I just want to understand how you work!

Here's a quick scenario: Your school is building a solar-powered robot for a competition. Which part excites you most?

- 💻 Writing the code that makes it move and think
- ⚙️ Designing the gears, wheels, and mechanical parts
- ⚡ Wiring the solar panels, sensors, and circuits
- 📐 Calculating the load capacity and structural design
- 🧥 Making it look sleek and user-friendly

When you face a tough problem — say a challenging maths question or a broken gadget — what's your instinct?

- 📝 Break it down step-by-step logically
- 💡 Brainstorm creative, out-of-the-box solutions
- 👐 Start experimenting and learn by doing
- 📚 Research online or ask someone who knows

Now let's talk about your exam performance. What is your JEE Main rank or percentile? If you have JEE Advanced, KCET, or any state exam rank, share that too.

Don't worry if you haven't appeared yet — just share your expected range!
Got it! Are you targeting IITs (JEE Advanced) or NITs/state colleges? And is this rank from 2024–25 or an earlier attempt?

What's your family's comfortable annual budget for college fees?

- 🟢 Under ₹2 lakh/year (government colleges)
- 🟡 ₹2–5 lakh/year (NITs, IIITs, some private)
- 🟠 Above ₹5 lakh/year (BITS, VIT, Manipal, etc.)

No judgement here — great options exist at every budget!
Would you consider education loans or scholarships to attend a premium college, or is the budget a hard constraint?

Do you have a preferred state or city for college? Or are you open to relocating anywhere in India?

Some students prefer staying close to home, others want a specific city. Just tell me what works for you!
Are there any states or regions you'd prefer to avoid? For example, language barriers or family constraints.

Your scores are close between two branches! Let's narrow it down: imagine yourself 5 years into your career. Which project would make you prouder — building software that millions use, or designing a physical structure or machine that people can see and touch?
Imagine a group project: one team builds a robot's brain (software/AI), another builds its physical body (mechanical/circuits). Which team excites you more to join, and why?

Here's what I've understood about you so far. I'll now generate your personalised college recommendations based on your profile. Does anything look incorrect that you'd like to update before I finalise?
Based on your answers, I'm ready to show you your college list across Safe, Moderate, and Dream tiers. Type 'yes' to proceed or share any corrections!
